gaps.sentence: They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.

gaps.sentence: Feel free to drop ___ for a coffee any time.
gaps.explanation: drop in = pay a casual visit; drop off = fall asleep or deliver.

gaps.sentence: She's taken ___ knitting to relax after work.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby, sport, activity).

gaps.sentence: The fire blew ___ the gas cylinder exploded.
gaps.explanation: blow up = explode, or make something explode.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).
